title: The Battleship Potemkin
description: When they are fed rancid meat, the sailors on the Potemkin revolt against their harsh conditions. Led by Vakulinchuk, the sailors kill the officers of the ship to gain their freedom. Vakulinchuk is also killed, and the people of Odessa honor him as a symbol of revolution. Tsarist soldiers arrive and massacre the civilians to quell the uprising. A squadron of ships is sent to overthrow the Potemkin, but the ships side with the revolt and refuse to attack.

title: The Lady With a Lamp
description: In the early 1840s, Florence Nightingale, daughter of a respected, wealthy Englishman, shocks her parents by choosing an education in nursing over her duty to marry and raise a family. Years later, in defiance of chauvinistic government officials and with only the support of Secretary at War Sidney Herbert, Florence brings many of the nurses she has trained into the Crimea, to tend to war-ravaged soldiers with her progressive nursing methods.
